notes: I-vi-1 fixed: 'Loại bỏ' is a complete, unconjugated action label per the vi guide. It stays distinct from Xóa = Delete (chat.dialogs.delete_action, projects delete) and Hủy = Cancel (create.cancel, schedule.cancel 'Hủy gửi'), so it does not read as delete or unsend. It is a single lexical word (one word per the context row) and appears nowhere else in the vi catalogues, so there is no clash. The NFC precomposed form is used (U+1EA1, U+1ECF). 7 characters.
